inlines.v: GRAT'IFY, verb transitive [Latin gratificor; gratus, agreeable, and facio, to make.] 1. To please; to give pleasure to; to indulge; as, to gratify the taste, the appetite, the senses, the desires, the mind, etc. 2. To delight; to please; to humor; to soothe; to satisfy; to indulge to satisfaction. For who would die to gratify a foe? 3. To requite; to recompense.
